scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

review_observations.method: All 241 whole-frame thumbnails plus25 larger whole samples, five native face windows and native whole frames60/90/110/210 viewed; not continuous normal-speed playback.
review_observations.actual_motion: Front hold through about1.7s; side turn about2-3s; near-profile stance through about4s; front again about4.5-5s; approach begins around8s and continues at end. Does not achieve planned settled near ending.
review_observations.identity_clothing_background: Recognizable identity/hair and navy blazer, gray tee, cream trousers retained in reviewed views. Blank right wall, bench, left window and floor broadly stationary; no new architecture detected.
review_observations.feet_bag: No obvious gross foot/hand distortion in reviewed views; black bag becomes far-side occluded during profile and visible again on return. Tiny shoe/strap details not certified on every native frame.
review_observations.limits: Side turn exceeds planned35deg; front hold is longer than prompt target. End remains walking; feet progressively leave frame with approach. Source naturalness and final transition comfort await user playback.
